page_title: WOL 0-1 ARS | Wolves v Arsenal 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Michael Oliver is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Arsenal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Gabriel Martinelli will be replaced by Kieran Tierney (Arsenal).
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Matt Doherty (Wolves) will be replaced by Goncalo Guedes.
87' Vitor Pereira prepares a substitution. Andre is replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
87' Here is a change. Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Gomes.
86' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tested David Raya with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
84' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the left side of the goal that is easily dealt with by David Raya.
83' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
79' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Sarabia departs the field of play to be replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
74' 0 - 1 Goal! Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
74' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
73' Arsenal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' Joao Gomes (Wolves) receives a yellow card from Michael Oliver and because it's his second he will have an early bath.

64' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
64' It will be a corner kick for Wolves.

64' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
63' The free kick finds Kai Havertz (Arsenal) in space in the box, but he can't keep his header down and sends it just over the bar from close range.
60' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) displays brilliant awareness in the penalty box and sends in a first-time shot. He didn't hit the ball properly and it goes well wide of the left post.
59' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but David Raya makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
59' Declan Rice (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but Jose Sa punches the ball away.
58' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
56' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
54' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Arsenal comes to nothing.

54' Declan Rice (Arsenal) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Jose Sa's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the top of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Declan Rice (Arsenal) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Arsenal.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Arsenal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Mikel Arteta makes a half-time substitution. Riccardo Calafiori comes on in place of Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+4' What a miskick by Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is booked.
43' Michael Oliver shows a red card with no hesitation. Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
43' Arsenal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
39' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
39' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) as his effort only hit the wall.
38' Andre (Wolves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Arsenal win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
36' Joao Gomes (Wolves) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Michael Oliver lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
35' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) is able to continue to play.
34' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Jorgen Strand Larsen is being substituted because of an injury. Vitor Pereira sends Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) on the pitch.
30' The game is interrupted now, Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
26' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
24' Jose Sa makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Kai Havertz (Arsenal) after a cross from the side.
23' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
20' A cross is whipped in towards Kai Havertz (Arsenal) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
18' Declan Rice (Arsenal) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
13' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
11' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
8' Michael Oliver couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Thomas Partey (Arsenal) and blew his whistle. Wolves have been awarded a free kick.
4' The Arsenal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver is the one to supervise the game today.
